description: One public X (Twitter) post by URL or ID from the JSON behind X's official embed widget: text, language, date, like and reply counts, edit status, reply-to, links, hashtags, mentions, photos and video (poster, duration, MP4 variants), quoted post, and the author (name, handle, blue check, label). Retweet, view and bookmark counts are not in this source. Timelines and search need X's paid API. Deleted or protected posts return 404. Related tools on this server, for a different need: social_x_com_profiles when you need public X profiles for up to 10 usernames via the free. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

post.description: Post URL (x.com or twitter.com /status/<id>) or numeric post ID
